content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking advice on how to control an analog signal using a digital input. The analog sensor signal is continuously on. With a button (pressed or not), I want the analog signal to pass to the output only when the button is active; otherwise, the output should be disabled and receive no signal. What is the programming approach for this in [product_name] [version_no]? Any guidance is appreciated. Thank you.
Please see the attachment for a possible solution. You can use the Analog-MUX function or an Arithmetic Instruction.
Thank you very much! This solution works perfectly for my requirements. Appreciate your help.
